scientific_question: Can connection-isolated paired measurements resolve exactly the four V5 candidate-versus-fused comparisons that remained inconclusive in the frozen pollution-safe V2 inference?

measurement_protocol.connection_isolation: one persistent DuckDB connection per candidate within each pair
measurement_protocol.order_control: equal counts of fused-candidate and candidate-fused orders, deterministically shuffled
measurement_protocol.primary_ratio: candidate latency divided by fused latency in the same paired block
measurement_protocol.confidence_interval: 95 percent order-stratified paired bootstrap median-ratio interval with 20000 repetitions

predeclared_decision_rules.materially_faster: confidence interval upper bound is below 0.97
predeclared_decision_rules.materially_slower: confidence interval lower bound is above 1.03
predeclared_decision_rules.practically_equivalent: the complete confidence interval lies within [0.97, 1.03]

governance_rule: Apply policy-profile feasibility before constructing an optimizer label. A faster governance-illegal candidate is excluded rather than selected.
interpretation_boundary: This protocol can authorize development labels for Optimizer V5. It is not an external holdout evaluation and cannot by itself establish final optimizer generalization.
